title: tanacetum suaveolens
intro: Tanacetum suaveolens, commonly known as Sweet Chamomile or Pineapple Chamomile, is a flowering plant native to southern Europe and western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to calm the digestive system, soothe anxiety and insomnia, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Chamomile are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenes, and sesquiterpenes, and it is used to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Chamomile have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
